definition: μνημεῖον, -ου, τό  [in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;] __1. a memorial, record (cl., cf. Wis.10:7).  __2. (a) (cl.) a monument: Luk.11:47;  __(b) a sepulchre, tomb  (Gen.23:6, 9, Isa.22:16, al.): Mat.23:29, Mrk.5:2, Luk.11:44, Jhn.5:28, and frequently in Gospels, Act.13:29  SYN.: μνῆμα  (AS)
